title: Sovereign Navy — Investment-Grade Deck Cover
description: A Goldman-Sachs-register cover built on a near-black navy ground, with transitional serif title in bone white, tracked small-caps subtitle, and a hairline-framed wordmark at foot. Set apart by its rigorously empty field — gravitas through restraint, not ornament.
philosophy: This template exists for rooms where credibility must be established before the first data point appears. It treats typographic hierarchy as the sole design language and empty space as a premium material. It refuses gradients, icon sets, and any decorative motif that would dilute the authority of the serif. It is built for senior bankers and institutional fund managers presenting to clients for whom confidence is signaled by what is left out, not what is added.
goodFor: Investment banking and M&A client-deck opening slides
Private equity or private wealth pitch book covers
Annual report cover slides for financial services firms
avoidFor: Startup founder pitches relying on approachable, energetic brand tone
Chart-heavy quarterly review sections with dense competing data
Consumer-facing brand presentations requiring warmth or vivid color
Casual internal team stand-ups or operational progress updates
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like the antechamber to a significant decision — still, authoritative, and unhurried. Compositionally symmetrical with a single vertical axis of gravity pulling title, subtitle, and footer wordmark into quiet alignment. The dominant material is empty dark ground; text is an event, not a pattern. Avoid any element that implies motion, warmth, or approachability — this is not a welcome mat, it is a credential.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
  <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#081628"/>

  <line x1="960" y1="150" x2="960" y2="210" stroke="#3aa8c8" stroke-width="1"/>

        fill="#3aa8c8">

  </text>

  <!-- Hairline rule above the title -->
  <line x1="870" y1="392" x2="1050" y2="392" stroke="#3a5068" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Primary headline, serif, mixed roman + italic -->
  <text x="960" y="520" text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif"
        font-size="112" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="-2"
        fill="#e8edf2">
    <tspan font-style="normal">The Sovereign</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="960" y="650" text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif"
        font-size="112" font-weight="400" font-style="italic" letter-spacing="-2"
        fill="#e8edf2">
    Allocation Review
  </text>

  <!-- Dek / subtitle -->
  <text x="960" y="740" text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif"
        font-size="28" font-weight="400" font-style="italic"
        fill="#3a5068">
    A fiduciary appraisal of long-duration capital across fixed income,
  </text>
  <text x="960" y="780" text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif"
        font-size="28" font-weight="400" font-style="italic"
        fill="#3a5068">
    private credit, and sovereign-grade opportunities — Fourth Quarter.
  </text>

  <!-- Meta line: presented to / prepared by, centered, tracked sans -->
  <text x="960" y="866" text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
        font-size="15" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="6"
        fill="#3a5068">
    PREPARED FOR THE INVESTMENT COMMITTEE  ·  24 APRIL 2026
  </text>

  <!-- Footer hairline frame -->
  <rect x="80" y="960" width="1760" height="72"
        fill="none" stroke="#3a5068" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Wordmark inside the footer frame, center-aligned -->
  <text x="960" y="1006" text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif"
        font-size="22" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="12"
        fill="#e8edf2">
    S O V E R E I G N  <tspan fill="#3aa8c8">·</tspan>  N A V Y   C A P I T A L
  </text>

  <!-- Small accent register marks at frame corners — disciplined, not decorative -->
  <line x1="80" y1="960" x2="80" y2="945" stroke="#3a5068" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="1840" y1="960" x2="1840" y2="945" stroke="#3a5068" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid, title block centered and occupying cols 3–10, vertically positioned in the upper-middle third of the slide with roughly equal empty field above and a larger void below — silence is structural. A hairline rectangular frame sits flush at the foot of the slide, inset by the outer margin, containing the wordmark centered within it. No header band, no page number, no rule lines other than the footer hairline. All text elements center-aligned on the vertical axis.

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a page torn from a confidential offering memorandum — institutional gravity without ceremony, every element earning its place through hierarchy alone. Compositional rhythm is columnar and deliberate: rule lines do the work of ornament, whitespace is the dominant texture, and the eye moves downward through structured silence. The mood is one of earned authority — the kind that doesn't announce itself. Avoid any visual warmth, rounded forms, iconography, or asymmetric tension; symmetry and restraint are the only permitted drama.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with body content occupying cols 3–10, enforcing a 15% outer margin on each side that functions as structural breathing room, not dead space. A tracked small-caps section label sits flush-left at the cap line, separated from the body by a single hairline rule spanning the content column. Below, three to four items are stacked and divided by hairline rules — each item carries a left-aligned label phrase and a right-aligned or indented statement within the same content column, evoking term-sheet register. Slide folio sits bottom-right in small-caps; no header band, no decorative footer element.
